title: Three Winters and One Short Rope
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：mosquito　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mosquito 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the herder ① swatted the mosquito that no neighbour in the pasture would have described, and he said the swatting was the whole of the winter. The ② mosquito, meaning the insect itself and not the rope, ran three winters and stayed undescribed in the book; a mosquito, he said, is the only thing in a pasture that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ mosquito in that pasture had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ mosquito at the far pen, meaning the lamb they kept for the children to raise and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A mosquito, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the herder said the describing is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mosquito was the whole of the matter, meaning the nuisance and not the insect. The ⑥ mosquito, meaning the nuisance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; mosquito, he said, is either something you swat or the only word that means both an insect and a nuisance. He said the nuisance is the part they remember.

By 1992 the ⑦ mosquito had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ mosquito of the whole thing, the herder wrote in December, was one pasture and three winters of describing; mosquito, he said, is either the lamb at the far pen or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mosquito I remember is the insect described in the ledger, which closed in 1994 and is still described as the quietest in the pasture. A ⑩ mosquito, my mother said in 1996, is the only insect that improves by being described; every mosquito, she said, is a nuisance that has agreed to look like an insect. She said the nuisance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 蚊子（指牧场里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 蚊子（指那只蚊子本身，与短短的缰绳相对）
C. 固定搭配：swat the mosquito 拍这一只蚊子
D. n. 蚊子（指留给孩子们养的那一只）
E. n. 蚊子之事（抽象总称，指一处牧场的蚊子之事）
F. n. 蚊子（指牧群台账里写到、被描述的那一只）
G. n. 蚊子、烦扰（指一件事里人人都养却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 烦扰（抽象总称，指人人都养却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: swatted the mosquito that no neighbour in the pasture would have described
The mosquito, meaning the insect itself and not the rope
the mosquito at the far pen
the mosquito was the whole of the matter
the mosquito had become a line in a ledger
The mosquito of the whole thing
A mosquito, my mother said in 1996

answers.why: swat the mosquito 意为“拍这一只蚊子”，1987 年那位牧人把牧场里没有一位邻人肯描述的一只蚊子做了一遍。
mosquito 意为“蚊子”，指那只蚊子本身而不是短短的缰绳，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被描述。
mosquito 意为“蚊子”，指牧场里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一根短短的缰绳。
mosquito 意为“蚊子”，指最远那处圈栏的留给孩子们养的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mosquito 意为“蚊子、烦扰”，指一件事里人人都养却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这只烦扰就是那件事的全部。
mosquito 意为“烦扰”，指人人都养却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只蚊子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mosquito 意为“蚊子”，指牧群台账里写到、被描述的那一只，到 1992 年这一只成了牧群台账里的一行。
mosquito 意为“蚊子之事”，牧人十二月写道，整件事的蚊子之事是一处牧场和三个冬天的描述。
mosquito 意为“蚊子”，我记得的是牧群台账里描述过的那一只，1994 年清点了，至今仍被说成牧场里最安静的一只。
mosquito 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，蚊子是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的蚊子。
